designationHistory.indexText: Congress passed the Blackwell School National Historic Site Act, which provided for the Marfa school to become a park unit once the land was acquired.

sources.name: NPS, Blackwell School Laws & Policies (enabling legislation)

designationHistory.indexText: The Secretary of the Interior formally established Blackwell School National Historic Site after the Marfa school district agreed to donate the site.

authority.citation: Secretarial decision memorandum (July 17, 2024); notice of establishment, 89 FR 59771 (July 23, 2024)

designationHistory.note: The Federal Register notice was published July 23, 2024; the decision memorandum and Interior's announcement are dated July 17.

sources.name: Federal Register notice, Blackwell School National Historic Site, 89 FR 59771 (govinfo)
Department of the Interior press release, July 17, 2024
